chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan ibn Ali and Fudalah from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the will (testament) for the heir, and he said, 'It is valid.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to leave a will or bequest to an heir in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms the permissibility of bequeathing to an heir, resolving the juristic debate between those who viewed it as redundant and those who required explicit validation. This ruling underscores the testator's autonomy to distribute their wealth beyond the fixed shares of inheritance, a principle widely accepted in Shia fiqh as supported by the consensus of the Imams.
